key_facts: opencode is a Go-based CLI/TUI application for AI coding assistance (v1.18.31 installed)
Config format: opencode.json or opencode.jsonc (JSON with Comments)
Two config locations: global (~/.config/opencode/) and per-project (.opencode/ or project root)
Config precedence: global < project files < .opencode files (merged, not replaced)
Custom agents defined via Markdown files in ~/.config/opencode/agents/ or .opencode/agents/
Agent types: primary (user-facing, Tab to switch) and subagents (invoked via @mention or task)
Built-in primary agents: Build, Plan; Built-in subagents: General, Explore, Scout
JSON output via --format json flag on opencode run command
Environment variables control many behaviors (OPENCODE_CONFIG, OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR, etc.)
call_chains: opencode run [message] --format json -> returns raw JSON events
opencode agent list -> shows all available agents
opencode debug config -> shows resolved configuration
opencode debug paths -> shows all state directories
